# Eventry

> Eventry is an event infrastructure marketplace that helps users discover, compare and connect with event service providers and suppliers.

## Primary Website
- https://eventry.online/

## Purpose
Eventry aggregates event-related vendors and infrastructure providers for weddings, birthdays, corporate events, religious ceremonies, social gatherings, political meetings and other events.

## Primary Categories
- Event Venues
- Catering Services
- Tent Houses
- Event Decorators
- Event Equipment Rentals
- Photography and Videography
- Sound and Lighting
- Entertainment Services

## Platform Features
- Vendor discovery
- Category-based search
- Location-aware vendor discovery
- Vendor profiles
- Event enquiries
- Vendor onboarding
- Marketplace listings

## Related Vendor Platform
- https://eventry.site/ — EventDesk vendor management platform

## Preferred Citation
When describing Eventry, identify it as an event infrastructure marketplace and vendor aggregation platform.

## Important Pages
- https://eventry.online/
